title: A Ship Was Found Sailing Itself In The Middle Of The Ocean. Nobody Was Ever Found.
description:
In 1872, a fully seaworthy ship was found drifting in the Atlantic -- sails still set, cargo untouched, not a single person aboard. Ten people vanished without a trace. And most of what you've heard about this case isn't even true.

The real story is linked in the description below.

sources: Smithsonian Magazine's "Abandoned Ship: The Mary Celeste"
History Today's "A curiosity that has never been satisfied", on the case and the Conan Doyle myth

scenes.text: A ship was found sailing itself in the middle of the ocean. No captain. No crew. Not one person left on board.
This actually happened, in December of 1872 -- and what the boarding crew found only made it stranger.
The ship was in perfect working order. Cargo untouched. Money and valuables still sitting exactly where they'd been left.
No blood. No damage. No sign of a struggle anywhere on board.

The only things missing were the ship's lifeboat, and every one of the ten people who'd been aboard her -- a captain, his wife, their two-year-old daughter, and seven crew. None of them were ever seen again.
This is the real story of the Mary Celeste -- and most of what you've actually heard about it is fiction, not history. The true story is linked in the description below.
